reveal_en: The word "disaster" literally means "bad star." It comes from the Greek dis (bad) and aster (star), reflecting ancient beliefs that celestial alignments caused misfortune.
reveal_zh: 英文单词“disaster”字面意思是“坏星”。它源于希腊语的“dis”（坏）和“aster”（星），反映了古人认为天体排列会带来不幸的观念。
meaning_en: It reveals how profoundly ancient cosmic interpretations shaped our language and perception of misfortune.
meaning_zh: 它揭示了古代宇宙观如何深刻地塑造了我们的语言和对不幸的认知。

visual.motion: Stars slowly drift across a dark sky, forming constellations.
